title: Derived 3+2 nonlinear halo: retrospective fixed-prediction comparison
status: Specified before reading any new nonlinear-EOS prediction or score. Existing galaxies, outcomes and model-development history have already been explored; this is not prospective registration.
quartic_control: Retained as a distinct physical truncation control even if its predictions happen to coincide with another model; do not drop a family member after observing its results.
primary_sample: Original 131 SPARC galaxies and 659 outer rows; all supplied models must cover every original outer observation. Full 3034-row input is preferred; outer-only input is accepted and labeled.
primary_loss: Mean pointwise squared standardized velocity residual within each galaxy, then equal galaxy weight.
effect: Mean nonlinear_eos-minus-comparator galaxy loss; negative favors nonlinear_eos.
sign_tolerance: abs(L_left-L_right) <= 1e-4*(1+max(L_left,L_right)); evaluate only when both losses are finite.
sign_probability: Two-sided fair-sign binomial probability conditional on informative galaxy pairs; finite prediction wins over failed fit; joint failures have no sign. Holm6 covers all six prespecified sign comparisons.
interval: Marginal 95% whole-galaxy pairs bootstrap-t; percentile interval retained as secondary description.
wild_test: Two-sided null-imposed studentized mean-loss bootstrap d_g*=w_g*d_g with independent Rademacher multipliers at galaxy level; zero restricted intercept. Approximate under a mean-only null, not generally exact sign randomization.
p_value: (exceedances+1)/(draws+1), with raw binomial Monte Carlo 95% interval and explicit resolution-floor flag. No extrapolation of zero exceedances.
continuous_multiplicity: Six prespecified slots. For a nonfinite full-sample contrast, no p value exists: retain a conservative p=1 adjustment placeholder only when Holm-adjusting other valid contrasts. Never publish the placeholder as that failed contrast's p value.
failure_policy: Any explicit fit_failed flag anywhere in a supplied galaxy/model block, or any nonfinite/negative predicted outer speed, invalidates that galaxy/model for continuous scoring. Keep all 131 galaxies in failure-aware signs. Full-sample continuous contrast is undefined when either model has a failure. Report feasible-pair effect and interval separately, without a primary p value; no arbitrary finite penalty, imputation, or hidden deletion.
uncertainty_scope: Conditions on saved predictions; no refitting, nuisance-estimation uncertainty, shared survey systematics, model-history correction, covariance estimation or new data validation.
secondary_descriptions: equal-galaxy MAE in km/s and absolute standardized residual
median and symmetric 10% trimmed paired differences
gaussian_equivalent: Unsigned two-sided normal equivalent norm.isf(p/2); never a field detection significance, test of GR, or proof of mechanism.
predictions_interface: predicted_rows.csv columns galaxy,index,radius,observed,sigma,is_outer,model,predicted; optional fit_failed and failure_reason. Speeds/errors in original catalogue coordinates, radius in catalogue kpc. A finite outer prediction does not override an explicitly failed training fit.
fixed_observational_reference: ../../pointwise_comparison_2026_09_25/data/pointwise_all.csv relative to the statistics directory; validate original galaxy/index, observed speed, quoted error, radius and split. Do not fit, repair, or reorder the experimental split.
